meta.name: board-meeting
meta.description: Multi-agent board meeting protocol for strategic decisions. Runs a structured 6-phase deliberation: context loading, independent C-suite contributions (isolated, no cross-pollination), critic analysis, synthesis, founder review, and decision extraction. Use when the user invokes /cs:boardroom, calls a board meeting, or wants structured multi-perspective executive deliberation on a strategic question.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用多角色模拟会议来推演战略决策
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在团队讨论前先系统性地评估多个视角
copy.tagline_en: Simulate a multi-agent board meeting to deliberate strategic decisions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need structured multi-perspective deliberation before making a strategic call

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会模拟一场由多个高管角色（如CEO、CFO等）参与的董事会会议。它先收集背景信息，然后让每个角色独立发表意见（互不干扰），再经过批评分析、综合总结，最后请创始人审批并记录决策。
howto.when: 当你输入“/cs:boardroom”加上议题，或者直接说“开个董事会”时触发。

say.text: 开个董事会，讨论是否要在Q3进军西班牙市场。
say.note: Claude 会启动6阶段会议流程。

say.text: /cs:boardroom 我们该不该收购那家AI初创公司？
say.note: 直接调用命令，Claude 会按协议执行。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude simulates a board meeting with multiple C-suite agents (e.g., CEO, CFO). It loads context, collects independent contributions, runs critic analysis, synthesizes, waits for founder approval, and logs decisions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you type "/cs:boardroom" followed by a topic, or say "call a board meeting".

say_en.text: Call a board meeting to discuss whether to expand to Spain in Q3.
/cs:boardroom Should we acquire that AI startup?
say_en.note: Direct command triggers the full deliberation.
